column1: # Per-TF Fiber-seq footprint pads, in the MOTIF's own 5'->3' frame.
# A TF absent from this file gets 0/0, i.e. today's unwidened behaviour.
# Read by make_meme_wide.py (sequence columns) and make_params_wide.py (Fiber vector),
# so the two layers cannot disagree about a TF's width.
# USER-SPECIFIED, per TF, from the measured footprints -- not a uniform +/-10 (cf.
# tf_pads_wide10.tsv). Same 12 TFs: those with >=50 Rossi sites, i.e. the ones carrying an
# FRAME. The widths were given as upstream/downstream on the Watson (reference) strand.
# That is the same thing as the motif's own 5'->3' frame here: a MEME motif IS its forward
# orientation, so its 5' side is the reference-upstream side wherever the forward block is
# placed, and robocop's reverse_complement mirrors the pads onto the reverse block. No
# Total extra columns 140 -> 280 new states -> n_states 3765 (baseline 3485).
